mapper.select: WITH first_assistant AS ( SELECT m.conversation_id AS conversation_id, m.content AS content, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.conversation_id ORDER BY m.id ASC) AS rn FROM ai_message m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.role = 'assistant' ) SELECT c.id AS id, c.title AS title, c.updated_at AS lastMessageAt, LEFT(f.content, 30) AS summary, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total FROM ai_conversation c LEFT JOIN first_assistant f ON f.conversation_id = c.id AND f.rn = 1 WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
